title: The Whispering Tree of Starvale
description: In the quiet village of Starvale, a curious girl named Mira discovers a glowing silver-leaved tree with a hidden door that leads to magical worlds among the stars.

scenes.description: Under the glow of a full moon, Mira spots a gigantic tree with shimmering silver leaves at the edge of the enchanted forest.
scenes.visual_prompt: A young girl standing under a starry night sky, looking up at a huge silver-leaved tree glowing in moonlight, whimsical storybook style
scenes.narration: One quiet night, Mira sees a glowing silver-leaved tree under the full moon.
scenes.subtitle: The Silver Leaves

scenes.description: Mira discovers a small, hidden door in the trunk, carved with tiny glowing symbols.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a tree trunk with a tiny glowing door covered in magical runes, a girl reaching to open it
scenes.narration: Curious, she finds a hidden door in the trunk, covered in glowing runes.
scenes.subtitle: The Hidden Door

scenes.description: Inside, glowing golden sap forms a spiral staircase leading upward into branches that open into magical realms.
scenes.visual_prompt: Inside a tree, a glowing spiral staircase made of golden sap leading upward into shimmering light
scenes.narration: She steps inside and finds a golden spiral staircase leading to magical worlds among the branches.
scenes.subtitle: The Golden Staircase

scenes.description: Mira meets Lumo the firefly and Nimbus the cloud-sailing fox, who guide her through candy clouds and crystal caves.
scenes.visual_prompt: A glowing firefly and a fox on a cloud guiding a girl through a candy-colored sky and crystal caves
scenes.narration: With her new friends Lumo and Nimbus, Mira explores candy clouds and crystal caves.
scenes.subtitle: Friends Among the Branches

scenes.description: On the highest branch, Mira meets Tiny the dragon, who gives her the final riddle to find the Heartseed.
scenes.visual_prompt: A small, cute dragon with glittering scales sitting on a glowing branch, speaking to a girl
scenes.narration: At the very top, Tiny the dragon shares the last riddle and the secret of the Heartseed.
scenes.subtitle: The Final Riddle

scenes.description: Mira plants the Heartseed in her village, and a new magical tree blooms under the starlight.
scenes.visual_prompt: A glowing magical tree sprouting in a village square under a star-filled sky, people watching in awe
scenes.narration: Mira plants the Heartseed, and a new magical tree blooms, lighting up Starvale forever.
scenes.subtitle: The Gift of the Tree
